basic_details.job_title: KUDSIT Assistant Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology is filling one post of Assistant Manager (Business Development) on contract, initially for one year, at Rs.50,000 to 60,000 per month (consolidated). The essential qualification is an MBA with a minimum of 60% marks and 3 years of experience in sales and marketing, or an Engineering Graduate with a minimum of 60% marks and 8 years of technology sales experience. Applications are accepted online through the Recruitment Portal latest on 10.12.2026 (Job Code AMBD/112026/560).

how_to_apply: Apply online through the Recruitment Portal. The application form is available at https://duk.ac.in/careers/.
Upload scanned copies of the documents proving age, qualifications, experience, etc. along with the online application.
Fill in all the relevant fields. Incomplete applications, applications without the relevant fields filled and applications received after the last date are summarily rejected.
After submission, check the registered email regularly, because the test/interview schedule is intimated through the registered email only.
No interim queries after the submission of the application are entertained. Originals of the documents are to be produced as and when called for.

content_sections.heading: About the University
content_sections.text: The Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology issued this notification through its Registrar. It invites applications from qualified Indian citizens for appointment to the position on a contract basis. All guidelines for submitting applications are available in its recruitment portal.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only qualified Indian citizens may apply. The notice gives two alternative routes for the Assistant Manager (Business Development) post: MBA with a minimum of 60% marks and 3 years of experience in sales and marketing. OR Engineering Graduates with a minimum of 60% marks and 8 years of technology sales experience. The age limit is that the candidate should not exceed 40 years as on the last date fixed for the submission of application. The age relaxation is 5 years for candidates belonging to SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates. Candidates who are in the service of the Government of India or any State Government, etc. must obtain a No Objection Certificate from their Head of Office or Department when applying and keep it with them. If the certificate cannot be produced when called for, the candidature stands cancelled. The notice does not specify any desirable qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is on contract, initially for a period of one year. The term may be extended further based on performance and requirements.

content_sections.heading: KUDSIT Assistant Manager (Business Development) Job Description
content_sections.text: To perform all duties and responsibilities relating to business development and client coordination. To carry out any other related work or responsibilities as may be assigned by the University from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KUDSIT Assistant Manager (Business Development)
content_sections.text: Apply online through the Recruitment Portal. The application form is available at https://duk.ac.in/careers/ . Submit the application latest on 10.12.2026. Upload scanned copies of the documents proving age, qualifications, experience, etc. along with the online application. Fill in all the relevant fields. Incomplete applications, applications without the relevant fields filled and applications received after the last date are summarily rejected. After submission, check the registered email regularly, because the test/interview schedule is intimated through the registered email only. No interim queries after the submission of the application are entertained. Originals of the documents are to be produced as and when called for.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection is based on a test and/or interview. The test/interview will be conducted in Thiruvananthapuram district only. The notice does not give the date, the exact venue or the syllabus. The schedule is sent to candidates through their registered email.
